anomalies.evidence: probe-filters.log lines 12-16 (customer=411 אופק ביטוח ופיננסים): rows=0, pager="", export="אין שורות לייצא", window="⁦01/01/2026–16/09/2026⁩ · אופק ביטוח ופיננסים" — yet population="אוכלוסייה: ⁦52⁩ לקוחות … מתוך ⁦61⁩" and so_what="להתקשר השבוע לענבר אשכנזי מגלובל שיפינג בע\"מ ולמיכל תורג'מן…" are identical to the unfiltered run (lines 7-11), and the tiles still read 12 / 320,743 ₪ / 3. Screenshot: CEO-m2-drifting-empty-filter.png (table area cropped in crop-empty-filter-bottom.png — header row, then straight to the definitions row). Cause in code: ReportSurface.jsx:510 gates the 📐10 state-2 envelope on `payload.rows.length === 0 && (payload.population?.n ?? 0) === 0`, and the m21 RPC keeps population.n global under a customer filter, so the envelope (and its "נקי מסננים" action) can never fire for this path.

blind_spot.exec: This evidence cannot say whether a real CEO at mode 2 sees מ6's charts empty, or only a Playwright full-page capture does. Playwright resizes the viewport to the full page height before shooting, which re-measures every recharts ResponsiveContainer and restarts its animation — so a capture can freeze the series at frame 0 while a human at a fixed 1280×800 window sees them fine. The check that settles it, and it is one action: open http://localhost:5189/reports?tab=exec&report=staffing as the CEO with onboarding mode 2, without resizing, and look at the two cards — or read the sr-only twin table inside [data-testid="chart-card-scatter"], which holds the same rows the SVG should draw. What makes the artifact theory incomplete, and why I graded it blocker anyway: the identical capture path produced full bars on CEO m0, on FINANCE m0/m2 and on the three other exec surfaces at mode 2, and it produced the same empty plot twice on this one.
blind_spot.finance: Every number here is one date, and the aging surface is a pure function of that date. Today (16/09/2026) not one of the 35 open invoices sits exactly on its מועד-פירעון — the nearest is one day past it (פרויקט 1,554, sent 15/08, due 15/09) and eight sit at "0 ימים · שוטף" before it. That is precisely the boundary spec §3.1 says broke five times in one day (−1 ⇒ 0 ⇒ "שוטף"), and this run never touches it: no row exercises the boundary, so a sign error there would render as a clean page in all 35 screenshots. Checkable without me: put one invoice whose invoice_sent_at + תנאי_תשלום_ימים equals the run date into the data and confirm it renders "שוטף · 0 ימים" and is counted in the side tile rather than in 1–30.
blind_spot.hostesses: Every number on these four screens was read back from the same RPC that produced it, so this evidence cannot tell whether מ15's 'ציון אמינות' column is in fact the identical value Smart Match uses when it ranks a hostess — the very claim the screen makes out loud ('הציון הוא בדיוק reliabilityScore של Smart Match'). Checkable without me: pick one hostess from CEO-m2-reliability.png (רותם עמר, 0.759, 11 משמרות) and compare that cell against what src/lib/ computes for her in the module-4 assignment screen; if the two differ, the sentence on מ15 is false and no screenshot in this run would have caught it.
blind_spot.customers: Every judgement above rests on one dataset at one clock reading, and the single mechanism it structurally cannot reach is מ22's empty branch: `hasApprovedRun(payload) === false` in src/modules/11_reports/tabs/customers/CustomerSurface.jsx (NoApprovedRun + the ⑩ג hint reports.notes.tilesBasis). While an approved run exists in the shared DB, no URL, filter or permission can render it, so the sentence "טרם אושרה ריצת-ניתוח" and the claim that the four tiles then read that instead of 0 have never been seen on screen in this run — only in unit tests (CustomersTab.test.jsx:842). Checkable true-or-false by anyone who may write: stub report_m22_notes to return approved_run=null (or run against a DB with no approved run) and confirm the four tiles say "טרם אושרה ריצה" rather than 0, since a 0 there would read as "אין בעיות".
